name: Shirasaka Mei
source:
Affiliation: Nozawa Academy

The younger sister of [url=/c19333]Taichi[/url] and [url=/c19335]Mio[/url]. 
Mei is a well-raised girl who is honest, lively, and innocent.
She is not informed of the details of the incident involving her older sister, Mio, and is told that it was a traffic accident. Mei is concerned about her sister, who has been depressed since then, and is relieved that Mio has found happiness in the new home.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=804105]Getchu[/url]]
